evidence: Reads global attribute-context selector 0x13 twice via attribute_context_status_value_get; return is -2 on the observed status-6/status-7 or null-argument paths, otherwise calls opaque f_700065c1f0 on the supplied pointer and caps its low-byte result at 0x15 (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:32027-32055). The callee's meaning and status relationship are not established, so no semantic label is assigned.

Checks attribute_context_status_is_2_or_3, then calls an opaque helper and performs range checks and single-precision arithmetic to derive an integer result (decompiled/main/main_0054.c:22011-22052). The constants and helper outputs do not identify the represented quantity, so the function remains unnamed.

Requires nonnull second argument and a nonzero byte at owner+0x428; reads a nested provider pointer at argument+8, obtains the default provider via f_700183f6e4 if null, then calls nested_attribute_provider_get_float with property ID 0x32. It converts to signed integer, returns -2 for a negative result, values 0-4 unchanged, and caps larger values at 5 (decompiled/main/main_0119.c:11452-11483; helper semantic name in tools/data/function_annotations.tsv).

Runs setup helper f_7000cee140, invokes the same child initializer f_7000cec588 at 32 successive offsets from base+0x410 through base+0x3600 with 0x178 stride, then calls format_season_record_detail on the base object (decompiled/main/main_0088.c:39522-39621; callee name in tools/data/function_annotations.tsv). This supports initialization of a repeated season-record detail container; no field layout is claimed.

For input index x1 <= 0x1a, uses a byte lookup table at 0x7001d92f56 to select one of many local cases; most cases return encoded constants, while case zero calls get_context_status_9_if_valid and may index a second 32-bit table at 0x7001d93178. Out-of-range inputs return an encoded fallback (decompiled/main/main_0091.c:16225-16364). The table's domain meaning is unresolved, so no semantic label is assigned.
